seriesCleanup.title: Series Name Cleanup
seriesCleanup.description: Review similar series names and merge confirmed variants into one canonical series. Similarity is only a suggestion; every merge is explicit.
seriesCleanup.emptyDescription: No series name pairs currently meet the similarity threshold.
seriesCleanup.loadFailed: Could not load similar series names.
seriesCleanup.merge: Merge other name into this one
seriesCleanup.inaccessibleWarning: This pair includes books in libraries you cannot access ({left} and {right} hidden books). Merging is disabled to protect those records.
seriesCleanup.inaccessibleError: This merge would affect books in libraries you cannot access. No changes were made.
seriesCleanup.mergeFailed: Could not merge these series. Refresh the list and try again.
seriesCleanup.positionConflictWarning: {count} books have conflicting series positions. Confirming keeps the target series position when present; otherwise it keeps the first source position.
seriesCleanup.confirmPositionMerge: Confirm merge and keep the selected positions
seriesCleanup.truncated: Only the first 500 candidate pairs are shown. Refine the library's series names before reviewing more.
